calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, sum(closing_value) AS val FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, sum(closing_value) AS val, count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-22' AND DATE '2026-03-29' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'),
a AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 01:00:00'),
b AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-10 02:45:00')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS n_first, (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS n_second,
 count(*) AS matched,
 sum(CASE WHEN a.closing_units=b.closing_units AND a.closing_value=b.closing_value AND a.receipts_units=b.receipts_units AND a.adjustment_units=b.adjustment_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b WHERE b.store_key=a.store_key AND b.product_key=a.product_key)) AS only_first,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a WHERE b.store_key=a.store_key AND b.product_key=a.product_key)) AS only_second
FROM a JOIN b ON a.store_key=b.store_key AND a.product_key=b.product_key

WITH dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM dedup fs
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND cs.region = 'West' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category, COUNT(*) AS weeks, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) AS distinct_rows, ROUND(SUM(fs.closing_value), 2) AS raw_value
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cs.region = 'West' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
